characters.name: 程一舟
characters.design: Middle-aged male chief surgeon in dark green full-coverage surgical scrubs and cap, only eyes exposed, prominent scar on brow bone, rock-steady hands holding surgical scalpel, realistic gritty skin and fabric texture, lit by harsh surgical spotlight, front upper body view focusing on hand movements

issues: 手持器械疑似为镊子或持针器而非手术刀，且双手持物与设计要点'surgical scalpel'（单数）不符

characters.name: 苏芒
characters.design: Young female scrub nurse in light green full-coverage surgical scrubs and cap, only focused eyes exposed, quick light hands passing sterile instruments, realistic natural texture, cool dim ambient light from medical monitors, close-up upper body view highlighting dexterity

issues: 人物佩戴医用口罩遮住口鼻，与设计要点'only eyes exposed'不符
双手动作显示为手术操作而非传递器械，与'passing sterile instruments'不符

props.name: 无菌手术器械盘
props.design: Stainless steel sterile surgical instrument tray with neatly arranged scalpel, gauze, forceps and other surgical tools, matte metal texture with faint surgical light reflection, placed on green sterile drape, top-down view for clear tool visibility

props.name: 手术监护仪
props.design: Wall-mounted patient monitor with glowing digital vital signs display, soft blue-white light emission, matte plastic casing, acts as dim ambient light source in the operating room, side view placed on the wall behind the operating table

scenes.name: 县医院急诊手术室
scenes.design: Gritty realistic county hospital operating room, harsh overhead surgical spotlight illuminating green sterile drapes and operating table, cool dim light from medical monitors, wall clock in the background, desaturated cool color grade with subtle 16mm film grain, wide shot capturing the entire operating space

issues: 背景中出现两个时钟，与设计要点'wall clock'（单数）不符
场景呈现为现代先进手术室，与'county hospital'的 gritty 写实风格不符
